This website brings useful information and sources into one place: ADHD science, genetics, neurological symptoms, treatment, care access and accountability.

Pain, fatigue, sensory difficulties and disability can make already complex information much harder to use. If you are struggling, finding help should not require you to navigate dozens of disconnected documents. Start with a clear explanation, follow the detail when you need it, and reach the original source.
